description: This file defines a WebSocket client class for interacting with OpenAI's Whisper transcription API via real-time streaming. It manages connection setup, session configuration, sending audio data, handling server events, and reconnection logic.

classes.name: OpenAIWhisperClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client for real-time transcription with OpenAI Whisper API, supporting connection management, session configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to the OpenAI API and configures the transcription session.

methods.name: updateTranscriptionPrompt
methods.description: Dynamically updates the transcription prompt during an active session.

methods.name: handleServerMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages from the WebSocket server, emitting relevant events.

methods.name: sendInputBufferCommit
methods.description: Forces the API to transcribe buffered audio without waiting for VAD silence.

methods.name: sendAudioChunk
methods.description: Sends a PCM16 audio buffer to the API, encoding it in base64.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the client is currently connected.

methods.name: getConnectionState
methods.description: Returns the current connection state: connecting, connected, disconnected, or reconnecting.
